name: Jacuzzi and Magik Hands
address: 2218 McClellan St, Hollywood, FL 33020, United States
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows 'Add website' (no website field). WebSearch for "Jacuzzi and Magik Hands" Hollywood FL website/instagram/facebook/email returned no matching official site or social profile. A possibly-related MassageBook listing (massagebook.com/therapists/magic-hands-msg) surfaced in search under a slightly different spelling ("Magic hands" vs "Magik Hands") in the same zip 33020 with a mention of a 60-min session at $100, but could not be confirmed as the same business (page is a JS app shell, no server-rendered address/name matched on fetch) so it was NOT used as a data source.

social_media.evidence: No Facebook or Instagram profile found for this exact business name via WebSearch. The only close name matches (Magic Hands Massage Spa, Plantation FL; Healing massage by Magic Hands, Airbnb Services, Plantation FL) are confirmed to be a DIFFERENT business in a different city, not used.

email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field), WebSearch for business name + email/contact (no result), WebSearch for Facebook/Instagram (no matching profile to check an About section on). The unconfirmed MassageBook listing was not opened for contact details since the business identity could not be verified first.

google_business.photos_available_on_listing: 12 Photos (per GMB page text), but gmaps_photocycle.js only surfaced 5 image URLs, of which 2 were byte-identical duplicates (so 4 unique files).

fail_reason: Insufficient real, usable photos (minimum bar per FORGE-BRIEF 0.b / PIPELINE Fase 3 is 5 good real photos). Of the 4 unique photos recovered from the Google Business listing via gmaps_photocycle.js: (1) and (2) are near-duplicate wide shots of the treatment room/jacuzzi setup (genuinely usable ambiance photos, but only count as ~1 distinct usable image), (3) is a private/personal photo of a woman in a bikini unrelated to a massage/jacuzzi service presentation (old 2005 Canon PowerShot EXIF metadata, clearly not a business work photo, PROHIBITED per visual curation rules), and (4) is a casual selfie/portrait of the apparent owner (per curation rules, a selfie/owner portrait is never usable as a gallery tile, only as a small avatar). That leaves at most 1-2 genuinely usable ambiance photos and zero additional real service/result photos. No Instagram or Facebook profile could be found via WebSearch to rescue with more photos (checked per FORGE-BRIEF 0.b rescue rule before failing). Research was NOT degraded (full Playwright gmaps_detail.js, gmaps_reviews.js and gmaps_photocycle.js ran successfully and returned real, complete data); the business itself simply does not have enough usable public photos. Not rebuilt from fewer/inappropriate images per the hard rule 'never fabricate or pad with bad photos.'

reviews_verbatim.author: Daniel Gielchinsky
reviews_verbatim.text: Excellent massage and fantastic jacuzzi. Will return.

reviews_verbatim.author: Phelipe san juan
reviews_verbatim.text: The whole experience was absolutely wonderful. She was very welcoming and helpful. She was able to relieve the tension on my muscles expertly. I will definitely be going back next time I’m in the area.

reviews_verbatim.author: Alfredo Ruiz
reviews_verbatim.text: Therapist used natural olive oil, hands gliding like waves-kneading every knot from my shoulders to toes. It felt like floating in pure bliss, all stress melting away in about an hour. Utterly divine!

reviews_verbatim.author: Gym Life Brandon
reviews_verbatim.text: Excellent, wonderful soothing. If I could give it more than five stars, I would!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Ronnie Santarone
reviews_verbatim.text: She’s great at what she does!

photo_curation_notes.verdict: usable ambiance shot (jacuzzi + massage table + room), but owner is visible in-frame (fully clothed, not a portrait) - borderline, would need cropping
usable ambiance shot, same room, no person - best of the 4
REJECTED - private/personal bikini photo, unrelated to the business, 2005 EXIF metadata, must never appear on the site
REJECTED for gallery - casual selfie/portrait of the owner, not a gallery-appropriate shot (could only be a small avatar, not enough on its own)

no_site_build_note: index.html was NOT built. Per pipeline rules, a failed business does not get a demo site; building one here would require padding the gallery with an inappropriate personal photo and a selfie, which is explicitly prohibited.
